title: Geologic Map of the Santee Point  Quadrangle, Georgetown County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2012, Geologic Map of the Santee Point  Quadrangle, Georgetown County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-189, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; map face is noise. Units are grouped by terrace (Holocene, Silver Bluff), not alloformation. Thicknesses OCR'd with '|' as first digit (freshwater marshes '| to 40', spit deposits '| to 15') read as 1 (inferred, sent to review). Symbols QHsm and QPsbs inferred from placement; QHebr appears on the map face but its unit is not identified in the text, so it is not assigned. Other symbols illegible. Bodies of water skipped. No references on the sheet.
SUBSURFACE: page 1 has cross section A-A' (vertical exaggeration 50; scale 40 to -40 feet with SEA LEVEL marked); unit labels and drill holes along it are garbled in the OCR and could not be read. Terrace margins given as elevations: Holocene below 10 ft at landward margin; Silver Bluff 6-10 ft (page 1). Section uses sea level; no named vertical datum; base map 1927 North American Datum.
Re-read of page 1 for subsurface fields (single OCR map sheet; map face is noise). Units grouped by terrace (Holocene, Silver Bluff) as before; map symbols read from the legend boxes on a page-image tile (QHebr is the Holocene or Pleistocene beach ridge sand). Terrace-sediment margin elevations (Holocene <10 ft landward; Silver Bluff >6/<10 ft) are recorded as unit contacts and as stated unit tops at those margins (boundary inferred; no vertical datum printed). Thicknesses with '|' for the first digit read as 1 (inferred). Cross section A-A' (whole-page image checked): a surface profile only, -40 to 40 ft with SEA LEVEL, vertical exaggeration 50; it draws no drill holes, no subsurface contacts or faults and prints no horizontal scale, so no distances, holes or contacts are recorded and its small rotated unit labels along the profile are not read. No drill holes on the sheet. Bodies of water and legend-only symbols not recorded.
